LanguageData.GenderedBeds_GizmoDesc: Choose which genders can claim, be assigned to, or be carried to this bed.\n\nThe choice applies to every selected bed.
LanguageData.GenderedBeds_OwnersUnassigned: Unassigned from {0} because of its gender restriction: {1}
LanguageData.GenderedBeds_Setting_AllowGenderless: Genderless pawns may use gendered beds
LanguageData.GenderedBeds_Setting_AllowGenderless_Des: If on, pawns with no gender (some modded races, androids and so on) can use beds restricted to either gender. If off, they can only use beds set to "Any gender".
LanguageData.GenderedBeds_Setting_MedicalRespects_Des: If off, a bed's gender restriction is ignored while the bed is set to medical, so patients are never left untreated. If on, medical beds only take pawns of the allowed gender.
LanguageData.GenderedBeds_Setting_ShowOverlay: Show gender icon on restricted beds
LanguageData.GenderedBeds_Setting_ShowOverlay_Desc: Draw a small male or female icon on restricted beds when zoomed in.
